content.bridge_context: Introduction to geometric tools and the basics of drawing accurate shapes.

units.title: Geometry Tools
units.explanation: We use a ruler for straight lines, a compass for circles, and a protractor for angles.
units.dual_language_instruction: Show me a ruler. What do the numbers on it represent? / एक रूलर दिखाएं। उस पर लिखे अंक क्या दर्शाते हैं?

units.title: Drawing a Circle
units.explanation: A circle is a collection of points at an equal distance (radius) from a center.
units.dual_language_instruction: Use a thread and a pencil to draw a circle. / एक धागे और पेंसिल का उपयोग करके एक वृत्त बनाएं।
